'''2012 Match Play Championship Day 2 Brian Fred DS Executor: Meditation Chamber''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Brian Fred]] at [[2012 Match Play Championship]] (Day 2).


== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' [[Executor: Meditation Chamber]]
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 2
